thread:
maria.chen: Quick sync — prepping a customer case study + webinar with Voltix. Need interview notes, quote approval, and a PR/webinar cadence. Draft doc: https://docs.google.com/example/voltix-case-draft — who can own approvals on this? :spiral_notepad:
james.patel: I did the interview last Friday and uploaded recording + notes: https://drive.google.com/example/voltix-interview. Key quote candidate: "Redwood cut our inference costs by 42% while keeping p50 latency under 50ms" — customer ok with the language but we need legal signoff for the number.
devon.ramirez: Voltix said they're OK in principle but their PR team wants to review the exact quote. They asked for a 48h turnaround on their end.
maria.chen: Can we get internal legal review by EOD today? @anne.li could you take a look for competitive/accuracy concerns?
anne.li: On it. I'll check claims and need the benchmark run details + config that produced the 42% number. Please attach the CSV and the command used. Also flag any comparative claims vs named vendors.
olivia.marketing: Added benchmark appendix to the draft: https://docs.google.com/example/voltix-benchmark. Methodology section included (hardware, seq len, quantization). Note: this was median p50 throughput on r2.large with batching. @james.patel can you confirm this lines up with Voltix's internal runs?
james.patel: Confirmed — matches their run. I'll ping their infra engineer for raw logs and ask for permission to share the CSV with legal.
maria.chen: We want to pair the case study with a customer webinar in ~2 weeks. Proposed dates: Tue 2026-04-25 or Thu 2026-04-27. Need speaker list and run-of-show.
devon.ramirez: Customer prefers Thursday 4/27. I'll confirm availability for their engineering lead and CSM.
maria.chen: OK. Routing plan for inbound leads: route webinar sign-ups to SF queue "voltix-webinar" with tag "case-vol" and notify AE James. @olivia.marketing can you set up the registration page and lead routing?
olivia.marketing: Done — event page + form: https://events.redwood.ai/voltix-webinar. Leads go to Zapier -> Salesforce -> owner assignment to james.patel. Also added utm params for campaign tracking.
maria.chen: Do we have logo and quote release permission from Voltix? Need that for the press post and social.
james.patel: Got logo permission. PR asked that the quote remain embargoed until their internal PR clears it (they requested embargo until next Monday 2026-04-30).
anne.li: Legal reviewed the draft and applied minor edits for claim language and attribution. Diff attached: https://drive.google.com/example/legal-diff. I require the benchmark CSV and the raw log link to be attached before final sign-off.
maria.chen: I'll attach the CSV and notify Voltix that legal needs the raw logs. Also need a short social headline + 2 copy variations. Draft headline: "How Voltix reduced inference costs by 42% with Redwood Inference" — feedback?
olivia.marketing: Suggest toning to "up to 42%" or "as much as 42%" — Voltix asked for that phrasing. I'll draft 3 variations for A/B.
james.patel: Confirmed with customer: they prefer "up to 42%". Finalizing their approval now.
maria.chen: Great. Next steps checklist: 1) attach benchmark CSV + raw logs to legal, 2) apply legal diff to draft, 3) send updated draft to Voltix for final sign-off, 4) finalize webinar speakers + run of show, 5) prepare slide deck and schedule rehearsal. I'll update this thread once I push the final draft to the customer tomorrow AM. Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
